chars.ADIL: ADIL: a 27-year-old Moroccan man with short curly black hair and a short beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black joggers and white sneakers
chars.SIMO: SIMO: a 27-year-old slim Moroccan man with a black buzz cut and thin moustache, wearing a sleeveless red basketball jersey over a white t-shirt, blue jeans and a black cap worn backwards

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, inside a tiny abandoned stone hut in a cedar forest of the Middle Atlas near Midelt at dusk. ADIL points at a low inner stone wall with a clever look while SIMO, shivering and hugging himself, listens. A small butane bottle and a stale piece of bread on the dusty floor. Calm background at the edges, subjects in the centre, no text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, inside the dark little stone hut, a half-height stone partition wall splits the room. ADIL checks behind the partition wall, SIMO holds a folded camping tent, both look tense. Dim light from a small window, no text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, ADIL and SIMO spread a flattened camping tent on the floor behind the stone partition wall inside the hut, kneeling, whispering, glancing toward the wooden door. Cozy but eerie, no text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, ADIL and SIMO lying hidden behind the low stone wall in the dark hut, only their worried faces peeking over the wall toward the closed wooden door. Moonlight through a small window, no text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, ADIL and SIMO sitting behind the stone wall sharing small round Moroccan breads (khobz) from a plastic bag, hungry and relieved, a thin candle between them. No text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, ADIL and SIMO wrapped together under the flattened tent like a blanket behind the stone wall, eyes half closed, finally warm and smiling slightly. Dark stone hut, no text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, exterior of a tiny lonely stone hut in a dark cedar forest of the Middle Atlas at night, full moon above, the only light is the moonlight, cold blue tones, silent and eerie, no people, no text.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, inside the pitch-dark hut at midnight, the wooden door slowly creaks open letting in a stripe of moonlight and the dark silhouette of a tall unknown figure in the doorway (face not visible). In the foreground ADIL and SIMO hide behind the stone wall, wide-eyed with terror, hands over their mouths. No text.
